description: Mid-game instant payouts (yao-dao and an-gang events), settled outside the winning hand.

entries.title: Cat and rat together
entries.cite: TT SS-Instant payment: a one-time payout by all playing parties for cat+mouse, chicken+centipede, all four animals, both seat flowers, and a complete flower group. TT Note 1.2: 'The payout above is cumulative.' TT Note 1.3 pegs the agreed rate to a one-point Self-Pick, i.e. 2 units per player, with an An Gang level event worth double.
